title: Constant scalar restriction and one ordinary finite quotient
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of Q_l, with valuation ring R and its fixed uniformizer t [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme T and one index n >= 0, use the completed coefficient ring and its projection to the constant R/(t^(n+1)) sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Let F be ordinary restriction along constant R to completed coefficients, followed by the fixed small-site equivalence [lem-sf-cbc-extension-zero-completion]. Let I be the lifted ideal (t) in ULift R. The map F(unit_n(M)) is epic for every completed-coefficient module M. There is a natural isomorphism between completed scalar reduction at n followed by F and F followed by constant scalar reduction at n [lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction, lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. Its composite with F(unit_n(M)) is exactly the nth component of the constant reduction unit. The assertion is ordinary and finite-level: it includes neither transitions between different n nor localization of complexes.

source.place: Tag 093M (lemma-completion-flat) and Tag 03EK (section-tensor-product); also literature/stacks-project/proetale.tex, Tag 099L (section-derived-completion-noetherian); finite-quotient part of Step 5 of lem-sf-constant-semilinear-generator-comparison.

proof.text: The valuation ring is a DVR, hence a principal ideal ring and Noetherian, by lem-weil-l-adic-extension-integers-dvr. Put R = O_E and I = (the fixed uniformizer). Use the completed constant algebra finite-quotient assertions of lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence and the projection equations of def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients. They identify the completed projection with the quotient by I^(n+1), with the same constants as the constant quotient. Transport to and from the published small-site model using the fixed constant-ring comparison of lem-sf-cbc-extension-zero-completion. All coefficient identifications are induced by the actual quotient homomorphism.

Scalar extension along the completed projection, with the unit of lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction, is the ordinary sheaf quotient M/I^(n+1)M. Its unit is locally surjective, hence epic; this is the quotient-unit argument of lem-weil-pbc-ordinary-common-quotient-tower at one level. Exact restriction to constant scalars leaves the underlying abelian sheaf unchanged, and the fixed small-site equivalence preserves epimorphisms, so the displayed restricted unit is epic.

The constant quotient of the restricted module has the same universal property. Tensor reassociation, or the finiteComparison construction of lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence with the coefficient identifications of Step 1, gives a map sending the class of m to itself in both directions. The quotient universal property proves they are inverse and natural in M. Both units send m to the class of m, proving the displayed unit equation. This is a finite-level result and contains no tower-transition or derived-localization assertion.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryScalarQuotientComparison (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ) :
    let F := SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (integralConstantToCompletionOfUniverses l E T) ⋙
      sfCbcModelModules T (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)
    let I := (Ideal.span {Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E}).map
      (ULift.ringEquiv.symm.toRingHom :
        Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E →+*
          ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))
    (∀ M : scalarReductionSource l E T,
      Epi (F.map ((scalarReductionExtension_adjunction l E T n).choose.unit.app M))) ∧
    ∃ e : sfReductionRestricted l E T n ⋙ F ≅
        F ⋙ ConstantCompletion.reduction (proEtaleModelTopology T)
          (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) I false n,
      ∀ M : scalarReductionSource l E T,
        F.map ((scalarReductionExtension_adjunction l E T n).choose.unit.app M) ≫
          e.hom.app M =
        ((ConstantCompletion.reductionUnit (proEtaleModelTopology T)
          (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) I false).app
            (F.obj M)).app (op n)
